about: Registry of known-open defects that tools/test_all.js accepts as KNOWN rows. A suite prints one stdout line per row, exactly 'KNOWN <id> <push>: <description>', and does not count it as a failure. test_all FAILs on a KNOWN id that is not listed here, on a push that does not match, on a row printed by another suite, and on a listed row that its step no longer prints (stale: remove the entry in the fixing commit). 'step' names the test_all step that must print the row.

known.description: taunt lines filled from a fresh or first-death profile print a plural or zero-count slip, or claim a history the profile lacks (B09); fixed by the line gates in P1.3
B21: at stake 7 the Called Shot goes live from duel 1, but rule cards show only in duel 7, so no CALLED SHOT card comes first; fixed in P1.3
V2: a mimic phase makes calls at stake 7 (the Mirror Rule; light 7 adds calls without looking at mimic, run.js callsOn); fixed in P1.2
feel-10 C3 / B08: Liar's Coin stamps turn 1 of every final-duel phase instead of once per final duel; fixed by the coinTurn1 gate in P1.2
O13: a pointer-down that only ends a pause reaches the scene and picks a move; fixed in the engine pause handling in P1.6
O13: a key press that only ends a pause reaches the scene and picks a move; fixed in the engine pause handling in P1.6
